subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw show for the `google-vertex` provider after Google’s Vertex AI branding moved under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection proves stale visible copy, but the issue’s requested wording differs from current Google Cloud wording and provider ids must stay stable unless maintainers intentionally approve a migration.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels and docs to bridge current Google branding with the stable OpenClaw `google-vertex` id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter’s proposed shorter wording even though it does not match the official Google Cloud wording checked here.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave current copy until Google SDK/API docs and OpenClaw provider docs are ready for a broader naming pass.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels and docs to bridge current Google branding with the stable OpenClaw `google-vertex` id.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already asked in the thread and has the strongest recent history on provider onboarding/catalog metadata that would consume the label.
